tdrs.decision: Cloudflare-native: Workers (Hono) for APIs, Pages for frontends, D1 (UK) for data, KV for sessions/tokens, R2 for objects, Cron Triggers for scheduled jobs.
Do NOT use Durable Objects, Cloudflare Queues, AI Gateway, Vectorize, Workers AI, or Cloudflare Access.
Persistence is Cloudflare D1 (UK); all access goes through the core-data-access layer plus a run-once, in-order migration runner.
Money is stored as integer pence; timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC.
Idempotency (webhooks, cron sends, checkout-session creation) uses a D1 store keyed by the provider event/idempotency key (INSERT OR IGNORE) — not KV, not a queue.

Payments use Stripe Embedded Checkout (ui_mode:'embedded'); fulfilment driven strictly by the checkout.session.completed webhook, never the return page; cumulative refunds read from charge.amount_refunded.
Auth is JWT (Web Crypto HS256, 1h) plus KV sessions for Customer (signed link) and Owner; Guides authenticate by X-Device-ID validated per guide. No Cloudflare Access.
Departure capacity is enforced by an atomic D1 transactional decrement of held/confirmed counts — NOT Durable Objects, NOT held_until+sweep.
Outbound transactional email is Postmark for v1.
SMS/WhatsApp delivery: direct Twilio vs Knock-orchestrated Twilio — undecided (D-NOTIF-1). Interim: direct Twilio, no orchestration lock-in.
Deploy to Cloudflare Pages (customer/admin/editor) + Workers (API) on friendsonbikes.uk; prod D1+KV namespaces exist; staging namespaces to be created; secrets set via Wrangler.
Canonical source repo is admin-rome (carries CI); rome-dev is spurious/superseded (DR-1). Local dev runs Wrangler against a local D1 — no in-memory substitute.

webapp-customer is vanilla static HTML/CSS/JS + Flutter Web island widgets, per-locale static dirs (en/fr/es); webapp-admin/webapp-editor are full Flutter Web SPAs; mobile-guide is Flutter iOS-native (primary) plus Flutter Web PWA (fallback).
Static publish is manual-only (operator-triggered rebuild of the customer site); no automated on-content-change trigger.
Design system = forest-palette CSS tokens + Syne (display) / DM Sans (body), self-hosted variable woff2; every customer surface renders from it; a Flutter component library is to-build.
The guide app (mobile-guide/GMT) stack is flutter_map + CyclOSM tiles + FMTC offline caching + sembast persistence + flutter_bloc + go_router + GetIt; offline-critical once a tour starts.

Advisory APIs: Met Office DataHub (forecast, free tier, via a Worker proxy so the JWT never ships to the browser) and TfL Unified API (use the street field — road is often null); both read-only, informational at v1.
